notes: Source titles NEED CONFIRMATION by the fact-checker: titles for sources 1, 8 and 9 were reconstructed from URL slugs; sources 2-7 use generic page names ('Bible Loop', 'Data safety: Bible Loop', 'Privacy Policy'). The arXiv preprint (source 10) title is not in the dossier or ledger, so the title field holds the arXiv ID rather than an invented title.
Sources numbered in strict order of first use (Feature 1-7, Also Encouraging 8-9, Wisdom Corner 10).

topics.json caveats honored: Nov 4 described as the 'official' launch, with faith.tools' 'on Google Play since July 2024' and the Oct 28-29 App Store updates stated (faith-11, faith-12). No '1 million' figure: only YouVersion's own '995K+' (faith-09) is used; Google Play's '1M+' bucket (faith-10) and the Christianity Daily headline are omitted. Audience described as 'young teens and preteens', with both executives' wordings quoted and the 13+/3+ ratings noted (faith-04, faith-05, faith-15, faith-16).

Privacy: dossier confirmed only partially, so the draft uses the dossier's safe wording (developer-declared disclosures, analytics data, not shared, no deletion request, data not linked to identity, general privacy policy). 'Collects profiles from minors' is NOT asserted. The profile-vs-account conflict is presented as attributed statements from the App Store listing (faith-14) and faith.tools (faith-22).
Study year: the release says 2021 but Barna pages are dated 2020 (faith-08). Draft says 'a OneHope study with Barna' with no year; Barna page not cited.

No geography: 'U.S.' dropped from the OneHope Gen Alpha study (faith-07); 'worldwide' dropped from the 3 million Challenge figure (faith-33); 'ASL' and 'American Sign Language' not used (national label), replaced with 'a natural sign language'; Deaf Missions' 'first full ASL Bible' item (faith-31) omitted because it cannot be stated accurately without the national label. URLs containing '/us/' or 'en_US' are URLs, not prose.

Omitted: faith-34 (print-or-app Challenge line) because its ledger URL is a Webull aggregator copy, which the style guide bars; faith-30 ('2%' figure, murky origin); MinistryWatch transparency grades; faith-28 user review requests; faith-25 (not needed); faith-08 Barna page.

citations.sentence: Helping young people memorize Scripture is a good aim.
citations.note: Rewrite: uncited line 'This week, Christian app makers are working hard to help young people memorize Scripture.' CUT per factcheck; replaced with this non-factual value statement so the paragraph still reads.

citations.sentence: YouVersion and OneHope officially launched Bible Loop on Nov 4, a free Bible app for young teens and preteens. The release says it was built 'at a stage of life when independence is growing and habits are forming'.
citations.note: 'officially launched' per topics.json caveat; audience wording per caveat.

citations.sentence: YouVersion, created by Life.Church, calls it 'the newest app in the YouVersion Family of Apps'.
citations.note: Rewrite: 'created by Life.Church' per release wording ('Created by Life.Church, YouVersion...'), replacing 'the Bible app ministry of'.

citations.sentence: faith.tools reports it 'has been on Google Play since July 2024'.
Updates on Oct 28 and 29 added French, Portuguese and Spanish, according to the App Store's version notes.
YouVersion now lists the app on Android and iOS in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French.
Its own product page counts '995K+ Installs across Android and iOS devices'.
citations.note: No 1M claim. Rewrite: 'just under a million' trimmed for length.

citations.sentence: Verse memorization game with anonymous leaderboard; Daily Check-Ins; Verse of the Day, Daily Prayers, 50+ versions across 10 languages.
The release says Learning Loops 'will add' these lessons, while the App Store's late-October notes list the feature as already added.
citations.note: Fact-checker confirmed Learning Loops listed as added in App Store versions 2.23.1 (Oct 28) and 2.23.2 (Oct 29).

citations.sentence: Google Play invites users to 'Level up your Streak as you read God’s Word'.
The App Store listing says users can 'Create a personalized profile to track your journey and progress'.

The release cites figures from an earlier OneHope study with Barna: 88% of engaged Christian parents of children 6-9 reported weekly Bible engagement, falling to 73% for 10-12. Parent reports from committed Christian homes.
citations.note: Rewrite: framed as 'from an earlier study'. Year still omitted (release says 2021, Barna pages dated 2020).

citations.sentence: OneHope says Gen Alpha, 'whose oldest are now teens,' spends an average of 4 hours and 6 minutes online daily. The release does not explain how that figure was measured.
citations.note: 'U.S.' dropped. Method statement from dossier ('methodology is not public').

citations.sentence: Gruenewald quote.
citations.note: Lowercase fragment as in ledger.

citations.sentence: Hoskins quote.
Apple rates Bible Loop 13+.
Google Play rates it for ages 3+.
These disclosures are written by the developer, not checked by the stores.
citations.note: Google wording 'The developer says...'; Apple 'not verified by Apple' per dossier and faith-19 claim.

citations.sentence: Google Play says the app shares no user data with other companies. It lists analytics data such as device IDs and app interactions.
It also says the developer offers no way to request that your data be deleted.
citations.note: Rewrite: paraphrased without quotation marks because exact Google Play wording could not be verified (fact-checker saw 'for users' vs draft's 'for you').

citations.sentence: Apple's label says collected data is 'not linked to your identity,' a claim Apple has not verified.
faith.tools reports that there is no account creation and progress stays on the device, a claim we could not confirm on YouVersion's own help page.
citations.note: Rewrite: attributed as faith.tools' own unverified report (its cited YouVersion help URL ends 'test-article'; help page itself unread, 403). faith.tools page last updated 2026-11-05; source date corrected from 2026-10-22.

citations.sentence: YouVersion's general privacy policy covers Bible Loop and says 'You do not need to sign up for an account'.
It treats minors only in general terms: 'solely responsible for providing supervision of the minor's use of YouVersion'.
The release promises more Learning Loops from 'partners teens love and trust'.
We found no public roadmap beyond that, and no outside review of the app yet.
citations.note: Dossier sections 6 and Unverified/gaps. Absence statement.

citations.sentence: MinistryWatch reported Nov 4 on ministries using animation and apps to bring the Bible to Deaf people. IMB and RevelationMedia plan an animated Gospel of Luke in a natural sign language, to be reanimated into other sign languages.
citations.note: 'ASL' generalized to 'a natural sign language' (no national label). 'World's first' and '300+' not used (not in ledger quote / superlative).

citations.sentence: Deaf Bible Society describes its Deaf Bible app as 'available in 92 sign languages and growing every year'.
30-Day Bible Challenge runs through November; YouVersion said Oct 6 nearly 3 million signed up in its first year; returns with progress/friends feature.
citations.note: 'worldwide' dropped.

citations.sentence: A 2026 preprint, not yet peer-reviewed, cites a study by Smith et al. (CHI '26) of Christian young adults aged 18-25, most often using YouVersion. It found a Bible app's 'streak' feature 'made some participants anxious and felt like an inauthentic way to track something as personal as scripture reading'. The preprint does not name that app.
citations.note: Rewrite: study named as Smith et al. (CHI '26) as described in preprint v2 (11 Sep 2026); sample given only as 'young adults aged 18-25' (preprint's further demographic label omitted per caller instruction); 'most often YouVersion' per preprint. Removed 'That app was not Bible Loop' (preprint does not name the streak app). 'Broke whenever...' quote trimmed for length. CHI '26 read only as described in the preprint.
